originalTitle: U.S. stock futures tick higher after Wall St slips on hot CPI, Nvidia losses
summary: Investing.com-- U.S. stock futures edged higher on Tuesday evening after Wall Street ended modestly lower, as hotter-than-expected inflation data reinforced expectations of another Federal Reserve rate hike, while weakness in Nvidia weighed on technology shares.
content:
Investing.com-- U.S. stock futures edged higher on Tuesday evening after Wall Street ended modestly lower, as hotter-than-expected inflation data reinforced expectations of another Federal Reserve rate hike, while weakness in Nvidia weighed on technology shares.

S&P 500 Futures inched 0.2% higher to 7,561.75 points, while Nasdaq 100 Futures rose 0.4% to 27,945.75 points by 19:27 ET (00:27 GMT). Dow Jones Futures traded 0.2% higher at 52,435.0 points.

In the regular session, the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.3%, while the S&P 500 lost 0.4% and the NASDAQ Composite declined 0.7%.

Data on Tuesday showed that the U.S. consumer price index (CPI) rose 0.4% in October from a month earlier, above economists' expectations for a 0.3% increase, while core CPI advanced 0.3%, also exceeding forecasts.

The figures followed a 0.6% monthly increase in September, indicating that inflationary pressures remained persistent despite some moderation in the headline pace.

The selloff also followed hawkish comments from Federal Reserve officials. Fed Governor Christopher Waller said he would support a rate increase in December even if inflation cooled, and argued that policymakers should consider a larger 50-basis-point increase if price pressures worsened.

Dallas Fed President Lorie Logan said the central bank needed at least two more quarter-point rate increases to bring inflation under control.

Markets are now pricing in a 91% chance of a 25-basis-point increase at the Fed's December meeting, compared with an 84% probability on Monday. The probability of a larger, 50-basis-point hike rose to 10%, according to CME FedWatch data.

In corporate news, Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) dropped about 5.5%, extending a steep decline amid concerns surrounding Chief Executive Jensen Huang and reports of an internal probe related to alleged chip shipments to China. The stock's weakness has added to broader concerns about stretched valuations in the artificial intelligence trade.

Meanwhile, CoreWeave (NASDAQ:CRWV) gained more than 5% in extended trading after reporting better-than-expected revenue and strong demand for its cloud services, offering some reassurance about continued spending on AI infrastructure.

Investors are also monitoring developments surrounding Anthropic's planned initial public offering, which could reportedly raise as much as $64.4 billion at a fully diluted valuation of up to $1.4 trillion, potentially testing appetite for large AI listings amid recent technology-sector volatility.

chineseTitle: 华尔街因消费者物价指数上涨而下滑，英伟达亏损，美国股指期货走高
chineseSummary: Investing.com——周二晚间，美国股指期货小幅走高，华尔街收盘小幅走低，原因是通胀数据热于预期，增强了美联储再次加息的预期，而英伟达的疲软打压了科技股。
chineseContent:
Investing.com——周二晚间，美国股指期货小幅走高，华尔街收盘小幅走低，原因是通胀数据热于预期，增强了美联储再次加息的预期，而英伟达的疲软打压了科技股。

截至美国东部时间 19:27（格林威治标准时间 00:27），标准普尔 500 指数期货上涨 0.2%，至 7,561.75 点，纳斯达克 100 期货上涨 0.4%，至 27,945.75 点。道琼斯期货上涨 0.2%，至 52,435.0 点。

常规交易时段，道琼斯工业平均指数下跌 0.3%，标准普尔 500 指数下跌 0.4%，纳斯达克综合指数下跌 0.7%。

周二数据显示，美国10月份消费者价格指数(CPI)环比上涨0.4%，高于经济学家预期的上涨0.3%，而核心CPI上涨0.3%，也超出预期。

该数据在 9 月份月度增长 0.6% 后发布，表明尽管总体增速有所放缓，但通胀压力仍然持续存在。

此次抛售也是在美联储官员发表鹰派言论之后发生的。美联储理事克里斯托弗·沃勒(Christopher Waller)表示，即使通胀降温，他也将支持12月加息，并认为如果物价压力恶化，政策制定者应考虑更大幅度加息50个基点。

达拉斯联邦储备银行行长洛里·洛根表示，央行至少需要再加息两次四分之一个百分点才能控制通胀。

目前市场预计美联储 12 月会议上加息 25 个基点的可能性为 91%，而周一的可能性为 84%。根据 CME FedWatch 数据，加息 50 个基点的可能性上升至 10%。

企业消息方面，英伟达 (NASDAQ:NVDA) 股价下跌约 5.5%，由于对首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 的担忧以及有关涉嫌向中国出口芯片的内部调查的报道，英伟达股价继续大幅下跌。该股的疲软加剧了人们对人工智能行业估值过高的更广泛担忧。

与此同时，CoreWeave（纳斯达克股票代码：CRWV）在公布好于预期的收入和对其云服务的强劲需求后，在扩展交易中上涨了超过 5%，这为人工智能基础设施的持续支出提供了一些保证。

投资者还在关注 Anthropic 计划首次公开募股的进展情况，据报道，该计划可能以高达 1.4 万亿美元的完全摊薄后估值筹集至多 644 亿美元，这可能会在近期科技行业波动的情况下测试大型人工智能上市的兴趣。
